foot_step_1.description: Dress shoe heel and toe on hardwood, variant 1 (mid board resonance).

foot_step_2.description: Dress shoe step on hardwood, variant 2 (lower boards, longer roll, clickier heel).

foot_step_3.description: Dress shoe step on hardwood, variant 3 (tighter boards, quick heavy toe).

foot_step_4.description: Dress shoe step on hardwood, variant 4 (slow heel to toe roll, light toe).

foot_stomp.description: Heavy aggressive stomp on hardwood with board rattle and room.

foot_scuff.description: Shoe twist and drag on hardwood with a short leather squeak.

clap_1.description: Single sharp hand clap, mid cavity with a tiny flam.

clap_2.description: Single sharp hand clap, brighter and tighter, no flam.

clap_3.description: Single sharp hand clap, lower and fuller, wider flam.

clap_big.description: One huge cupped stopping clap with a big room bloom.

slap_1.description: Open-hand face slap, meaty skin smack, variant 1.

slap_2.description: Open-hand face slap, heavier and fleshier, variant 2.

slap_3.description: Open-hand face slap, sharper crack, variant 3.

fist_slam_stand.description: Fist hammering a steel music stand desk with sheet music, desk ring and clamp chatter.

whoosh_big.description: Violent full-arm swing whoosh with low air rumble.

whoosh_spin.description: Spinning flat object flying past, pulsing whirr with a Doppler drop, about 0.6 s.

cloth_rustle_1.description: Shirt movement rustle, quiet by design (peak -12 dBFS).

cloth_rustle_2.description: Trousers movement rustle, heavier and lower, quiet by design (peak -12 dBFS).

body_thud.description: Heavy weight shift or lunge landing on the wooden floor.

stand_rattle.description: Metal music stand jostled, a burst of small clanks.

stand_crash.description: Metal music stand toppling and clattering on the wood floor.

paper_grab.description: Snatching sheet music, crackle and swish.

paper_flutter.description: Pages flying through the air, irregular flaps, about 0.8 s.

paper_land.description: Pages slapping onto the floor one after another.

page_flip.description: Turning one page on a stand, quieter by design (peak -6 dBFS).

chair_grab.description: Grabbing a folded metal chair, tube clank and hinge chatter.

chair_impact.description: Folded metal chair slamming into something and clattering on the floor.

drum_grab.description: Picking up a snare drum, shell knock and a slight snare buzz.

drum_impact.description: Snare drum crashing to the floor and bouncing, snares rattling.

cymbal_grab.description: Gripping a crash cymbal edge, finger tick and a faint choked shimmer.

cymbal_impact.description: Crash cymbal hitting and ringing, bright shimmering tail of about 2.8 s.

cowbell_hit_1.description: Hard stick hit on a cowbell, partials near 540 and 800 Hz, open ring.

cowbell_hit_2.description: Hard stick hit on a cowbell nearer the mouth, brighter and shorter.

watch_tap.description: Fingernail tapping a watch face, quieter by design (peak -9 dBFS).

finger_snap.description: Finger snap, bright crack with a small palm thump.

chair_creak.description: Player shifting on a padded metal chair, vinyl and joint creak, quieter by design (peak -6 dBFS).

instrument_handle.description: Soft clunk of picking up or setting down an instrument.

sax_keys.description: Saxophone key pads clacking, quieter by design (peak -6 dBFS).

trumpet_valves.description: Three trumpet valves pressed and released, quieter by design (peak -6 dBFS).

trombone_slide.description: Trombone slide swish ending on the stop, about 0.3 s.

spit_valve.description: Trombone water key click, a pfft and a few drips.

guitar_handle.description: Guitar body thump with open strings brushed.

bass_handle.description: Upright bass body thump with a low string buzz.

piano_bench_creak.description: Wooden piano bench creak with a small leg knock, quieter by design (peak -6 dBFS).

door_slam.description: Heavy wooden door slammed shut in a wood-panelled room, latch click and frame rattle.
